services.name: School Tours
services.desc: MoNA Docent volunteers make an enormous impact on the Museum. Not only do they help implement MoNA’s mission to bring Northwest art to our community, but they also make the museum a welcoming place for our visitors. The Museum’s Docents play a critical role in fostering a welcoming environment for people visiting the Museum galleries. If you are available to volunteer at the Museum on a regular basis, please consider joining our group of Museum Docents. Our Docents are a diverse and highly committed group of volunteers who are an important part of MoNA's education program.
